title.value: Scenario 0.2 - Serve medication agreements of person 'E-XXX-GBZ-SMOKETEST-A' filtered by identifier

description.value: Test of scenario 0.2 of the Medication Agreement Serve use case. See [the qualification documentation on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/mp:Vcurrent_Kwalificatie#Pre-kwalificatie_testgegevens_9.0.7) for more information.

Serve medication agreements of person 'E-XXX-GBZ-SMOKETEST-A' filtered by identifier and check the response. In the simulator, set 'filter-identifier' to 'urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.999.77.16076005.1|tsMBH_907_QA1_MA-GSA'. Expect exactly 1 MedicationRequest resource

nts:include.description: Receive a FHIR search on MedicationRequest, including the 'category', 'identifier' and '_include' parameters, and send a response
